external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are
external_entities.notes: Colleagues may include franchise colleagues, who do not have staff accounts with us.

external_entities.name: own device
external_entities.description: A colleague's own device used from home.
external_entities.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home
external_entities.notes: The text does not specify device security properties.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system supplying colleague and group membership changes.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

external_entities.name: own identity provider
external_entities.description: A franchise's identity provider that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not specify which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, signs tokens, and pulls directory changes.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker
processes.notes: Tokens carry staff ids and group lists. Nothing calls back to the broker to ask whether a colleague is still allowed in. Tokens are valid for twelve hours and cannot be revoked before expiry. The text does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

processes.name: application
processes.description: An application that takes the broker token and decides what the colleague may do from its groups.
processes.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that allows a holder of a store-manager token to change prices and void transactions.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the broker's token-signing key.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The broker's directory of colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory
data_stores.notes: The text does not state whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. The text does not state whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: enter sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague enters sign-in information on their own device.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home

data_flows.name: submit sign-in
data_flows.description: The colleague's own device submits the sign-in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home

data_flows.name: vouch sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: The text does not specify which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: fetch public half
data_flows.description: An application fetches the public half of the broker's signing key.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature
data_flows.data_description: The public half of the token-signing key

data_flows.name: read signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker reads the signing key from the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store

data_flows.name: update membership
data_flows.description: The broker updates its directory with changes pulled from HR.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The broker pulls colleague and group membership changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight

data_flows.name: change prices
data_flows.description: A colleague uses the console to change prices when the token contains the store-manager group.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices
data_flows.data_description: A token containing staff id and group membership, and price changes

data_flows.name: void transactions
data_flows.description: A colleague uses the console to void transactions when the token contains the store-manager group.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions
data_flows.data_description: A token containing staff id and group membership, and transaction changes

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log
data_flows.notes: It is unknown whether this flow covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network on which the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: The zone containing colleagues' own devices used at home.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise identity provider
trust_boundaries.description: The external identity-provider zone used to vouch for franchise colleagues.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

assumptions.assumption: The identity broker is internally exposed because it runs on the corporate network.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the identity broker runs on the corporate network.

assumptions.assumption: The store admin console is internally exposed because it runs on the corporate network.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the store admin console also runs on the corporate network.

assumptions.assumption: The key store contains confidential data because it holds a token-signing key.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the key store holds the broker's signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The directory contains confidential data because it holds colleagues and their group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the directory keeps colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log contains confidential data because it holds sign-in records.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
